content:
- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.5) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.5) in recent days, model tends to underestimate prices; increase forecast slightly.
- Model often overshoots after sharp price spikes (especially >10% in 3-5 days), leading to overcorrection; apply dampening factor to subsequent days.
- Forecasting horizon 30d shows persistent lag: model typically peaks 1-2 days after true price peaks; adjust for delayed reaction.
- Mean reversion bias: model frequently holds prices too high in sustained uptrends; reduce forecast by 1-2% for 3-5 day trends.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model tends to misalign with sentiment direction; align forecast slope with sentiment trend direction.
- For 30d forecasts, if true outcome shows early sharp decline (first 5 days), model often fails to anticipate; increase forecast downward bias in first 3 days.
